content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis and at least with 5 years of regular service in the LEVEL-11 in the PAY MATRIX or equivalent, and having five years experience in administration including the conduct of examination and admissions/arrangement of teaching program. Experience: Five years experience in administration including the conduct of examination and admissions/arrangement of teaching program. Other conditions: Initial period of deputation is for three years.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for PGIMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Officers with departmental or disciplinary proceedings pending or contemplated against them.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation basis initially for three years.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: ACR/APARs for the last 5 years Vigilance clearance Experience certificate mentioning job profile

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Forward the names of suitable officers through Cadre Controlling Authority along with ACR/APARs for the last 5 years. Ensure no departmental/disciplinary proceedings are pending/being contemplated against the officers. Send the application to the office of Director, PGIMER, Chandigarh. Make sure it reaches by 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Application must reach the office latest by 30/11/2026.
